blocks.html: Finally! The new and improved MallDash app is here, and it's packed with fantastic features that will transform your online mall shopping experience.
Here are some key features that we know you'll love:
One-Stop Multi-Store Shopping with a Single Delivery Fee!

Say goodbye to switching between different apps for your various shopping needs. With MallDash, you can shop from multiple stores all in one go - and pay for a single delivery fee! Whether you need groceries, clothing, electronics, or a delicious meal for any occasion, we've got you covered. No more juggling between apps or websites – everything you need is right here.
If It’s Late - Delivery is Free!

We understand that time is precious. That's why we're proud to offer guaranteed 1-hour delivery for small orders from 1 or 2 stores. Yes, you read that right! Once you place your order, our reliable Dashers will work diligently to ensure your items are at your doorstep in just one hour. No more waiting around – get your essentials when you need them ASAP. Learn more about our delivery guarantee here.
Pick-up and Scheduled Orders
For those who are truly in a rush, there’s the pickup option. You can also schedule the delivery on the next hour or up to three days, to get your items fresh and just in time for that special event.
You can even shop outside of mall hours by ordering in advance of up to three days and then choose an available delivery time slot on the checkout page.
Your Personal Dasher

We believe in the personal touch, which is why we assign a dedicated Dasher to handle your orders. Your Dasher will ensure that everything is just as you like it, from picking the freshest produce to carefully packing fragile items for delivery. It's like having your own personal shopper right at your fingertips.
Pabili Service

Can't be bothered to add items to your cart one by one? No sweat! Enter our Pabili service. Just snap a pic of your shopping list, and we'll handle the rest. We'll shop for you and ensure your essentials are delivered to your doorstep, hassle-free.
Payment Options to Suit Your Convenience

MallDash offers a range of secure payment options designed to fit your needs: debit/credit card, mobile wallet, or cash. To provide you with added peace of mind, we offer the flexibility to settle your purchases when your order arrives right at your chosen delivery address.
Lowest Upfront Fees

There is no membership required, no minimum spend for multi-store shopping, and everything is delivered at the same time! For that effortless online shopping experience, just pay a single delivery fee just ₱50 (for standard orders) and a small convenience fee of ₱19.
The Ultimate Convenience App

We get it – shopping can be overwhelming. That's why we've designed the MallDash app to be incredibly user-friendly. Plus, you can track your orders in real-time, so you'll always know when to expect your delivery.

"At MallDash, we're committed to providing you with the most convenient shopping experience. Our new app reflects our dedication to innovation, speed, and, above all, our valued Robinsons Mall shoppers and tenants. We're thrilled to introduce you to the future of online retail – the MallDash app." Kevin Dayleg, MallDash GM.
So, what are you waiting for? Upgrade your shopping game and experience the future of retail with the all-new MallDash app. Download it now from Google Play or the App Store! 🛒📲
